name: Craze
long_description:
Craze is the AI video platform where creatives make something people watch.

Brands, creators, agencies and studios use Craze to storyboard, edit, design and turn creative direction into social media content, ads, films and more.

Craze comes with a creative agent you direct, access to all top video/image/music/audio/media models, and a full timeline editor. You can also use Craze with your Chatgpt, Claude, Muse or other personal agents via Craze MCP.
one_liner: The AI video platform where creatives make something people watch

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Co-founder and CEO of Craze. I studied computer science at Harvard before dropping out to build Craze. Outside of work, I'm a die-hard fan of Manchester United, the Celtics, Indian Cricket, Mumbai Indians and the Patriots.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Deepit Patil is the founder and CTO of Craze. He was studying Computational Mechanics at IIT Delhi before deciding to drop out and build Craze.
